|date=At some point prior to the creation of [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] before 16,899 BBY<ref name="Date">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' (p. 27) states that latter part of [[Sorzus Syn]]'s chronicle took place in the "Exile Year Two, Months 7-9". Per ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' the first year took place in [[6900 BBY]], thus the second year would be [[6899 BBY]]. Page 29 states that the [[Sanctum of Sakkra-Kla]] was sealed more than ten thousand years before 6899 BBY, and lain undisturbed since, which would mean that the preserved body of a [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] was placed there before 16,899 BBY. Since terentatek is stated to be "among the more recent creations," the war that birthed the [[Silooth/Legends|silooth]], the [[Sith warbird]] and the [[Sith war behemoth]] must have happened prior to the creation of the terentatek.</ref>

{{Quote|During the same war that birthed the silooth, the Sith introduced the warbird and the war behemoth.|Sorzus Syn|<ref name="BoS" />}}
At some point prior to the creation of [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] before 16,899 BBY,<ref name="Date" /> the [[Sith Empire (Pre-Republic)|Sith Empire]] became embroiled in a '''war''' where the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] pressed into military service for the first [[Time/Legends|time]] various varieties of warbeast, including the [[Silooth/Legends|silooth]], the [[Sith warbird]] and the [[Sith war behemoth]], in order to aid their campaign. During one major engagement of the war, the [[Battle of Kalsunor]], hordes of mutated silooths were released by the Sith on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalsunor]], and the creatures proceeded to ravish the world.<ref name="BoS" /> Following the [[Discovery of Korriban]] in [[6900 BBY]],<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> ''[[Jen'jidai]]'' [[Sorzus Syn]] wrote about the war in [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|chronicle]], which was later collected by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] into his ''[[Book of Sith]]''.<ref name="BoS" />
